title: Sales and Service Advisor
description:
Location: Wakefield

Salary: £27,976 + potential quarterly bonuses up to £4,200

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday + 1 Saturday every 4 - 6 weeks

Indulge your passion for problem-solving and embrace the thrill of risk management as a Customer Service and Sales Advisor with Gallagher's global brokerage team. Join a diverse family united by excellence, safeguarding businesses and empowering ambitions. You'll receive comprehensive training to help you build a legacy of trust and success in the dynamic world of risk management. We believe every candidate brings something special, so even if you don't feel like an exact match, we encourage you to apply.

How you'll make an impact
- Create insurance quotes and renewals over the phone to provide the best price for our customers, making sure you recommend the right type of cover - always keeping your customers' interests at heart
- Look for all opportunities to upsell or cross-sell our range of products depending on the customers' needs
- Make and answer calls from customers and clients to gather information, provide updates, and talk through any concerns or questions they may have
- Leave the customer happy, with a positive lasting impression and an extraordinary feeling about our products and services
- Balance multiple tasks at the same time, utilising a range of systems and working in a supportive, friendly, and agile team

About you
- No previous insurance experience required
- Ability to explain complex language in simple terms, either in writing and/or over the phone
- Attention to detail because you'll need to accurately review and assess documentation
- Empathy and the ability to remain calm and composed when dealing with customers
- Customer service skills to provide a positive experience for customers throughout
- Computer literate

Benefits
- Comprehensive training scheme with opportunities for career progression and fully funded professional insurance qualifications (CII).
- Minimum of 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays, and the option to 'buy' extra days
- Defined contribution pension scheme, which Gallagher will also contribute to
- Life insurance, which will pay 4x your basic annual salary, which you can top-up to 10x
- Income protection, we'll cover up to 50% of your annual income, with options to top up
- Health cash plan or Private medical insurance
- Three fully paid volunteering days per year
- Employee Stock Purchase plan, offering company shares at a discount
- Discounted gym membership
- Access to a discounted voucher portal to save money on your weekly shop or next big purchase
- Emergency back-up family care

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity are core to Gallagher. For over 95 years, we've committed to sustainability and community support. We value diverse identities, experiences, and talents, enhancing our service to clients and communities.

As a Disability Confident Committed employer, we ensure an inclusive, accessible recruitment process, supporting employees with health conditions or disabilities.

Arthur J. Gallagher Services (UK) Limited is a proud Living Wage employer. We are committed to diversity and equal opportunity for all, opposing any discrimination based on protected characteristics. We provide equal employment opportunities in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship and make reasonable accommodations for disabilities unless it imposes undue hardship.

title: Part Time Accounts Assistant

Michael Page are actively working with a long standing client who are looking for a Part Time Accounts Assistant to join their team in South Leeds on a permanent basis. My client is looking for a proactive, and hands on individual that has experience working on both Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Credit Control functions.

Client Details

Michael Page are actively working with a long standing client who are looking for a Part Time Accounts Assistant to join their team in South Leeds on a permanent basis. My client is looking for a proactive, and hands on individual that has experience working on both Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Credit Control functions. This is a perfect opportunity for a candidate looking for a flexible, 30 hours per week Accounts role that can be tailored to your routine. My client is a well known business in their industry, known for their top quality working culture.

Description
- Process invoices and ensure accurate record-keeping.
- Managing processes for both purchase and sales ledger
- Reconcile accounts and resolve any discrepancies.

- Maintain up-to-date and accurate financial records.
- Support with credit control tasks

- Communicate with other departments regarding financial queries.
- Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies.

Profile

- Experience in an accounts assistant, finance assistant role is essential
- Wanting 30 hours a week split over 4 or 5 days.
- Familiarity with financial software and systems.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Ability to manage time effectively and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills to liaise with colleagues and external parties.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £30,000-£32,000 FTE
- Hybrid working - 1 or 2 days onsite, and the rest at home.
- 25-30 hours a week split over 4-5 days
- Flexible working hours to suit your routine
- Permanent position
- Free parking onsite
- Opportunity to be part of a high performing finance team known for their positive working culture

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Commercial Claims Handler (Personal Lines Handlers Considered!)
description:
It should be no surprise that when this dynamic insurer decided to build a London Market Claims Team in the UK regions, it plumped for Leeds - it has been established locally for over 20 years, already boasts a significant claims team that comprises many of the region's most gifted insurance professionals, and has recently invested significantly in the acquisition of penthouse offices in perhaps Leeds' most prestigious office addresses.

It is arguably the most exciting insurance company in the market right now, using ingenuity combined with technical expertise and cutting-edge technology to underwrite risks that other insurers shy away from. This 'can do' attitude, coupled with an unwavering focus on client service, is serving it well; the business is currently enjoying 20% year on year growth, and is well on track to exceed its plans to double in size within 5 years.

Working in this new team, you will be handling specialist Professional Indemnity claims from a range of industry sectors such as Solicitors, Architects, Engineers and Consultants. You'll take responsibility for handling a portfolio of high-volume claims from first notification of loss through to final settlement. You'll update in-house and London market claim related systems in relation to individual claims and ensure stakeholders are kept apprised of key developments and key information. In addition, you'll diarise and triage claims as required by the Claims Handling Manual and subject these decisions to regular challenge and review. You'll also develop and maintain excellent working relationships with brokers, as well as working with the Claims Manager on claims initiatives and projects to reach specific goals.

You DO NOT need to have experience in Professional Indemnity claims as full training will be provided. However, you must have some previous experience in insurance claims handling. We are open to experience here and will consider claims specialists from a range of backgrounds, including but not limited to, personal lines, commercial or healthcare insurance. Crucially, you must be well-organised and efficient, with strong communication skills and the ability to analyse claims data in order to spot trends. Just as importantly, you'll have good IT (Microsoft Office) skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook, together with the ability to quickly learn new in-house systems.

Our client is based a stone's throw from Leeds railway station, close to the main public transport links and all the amenities the city centre has to offer. You will be welcome to work from home 1 day per week. In addition to a generous basic salary, you will receive a fantastic benefits package that includes a lucrative bonus and an impressive pension arrangement.

Aston Charles - a personalised service from industry experts

title: Part-Time Accounts Assistant for Yorkshire Design Group
description:
Part-Time Accounts Assistant

Salary £28k -32k Full-Time Equivalent dependent on skills and experience

Leeds City Centre - Office based

Part Time, Flexible Working Pattern offered - 20-25 hours per week

Yorkshire Design Group is an established, family-owned property business with over 35 years' experience in the development, regeneration and management of commercial property in Leeds.

With a varied portfolio of properties and interests across two group companies, we are looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant / Bookkeeper to take responsibility for the day-to-day accounting and financial administration of the business.

This is an interesting opportunity for someone who enjoys the variety and responsibility that comes with working within a smaller, established organisation. You will work closely with the company's external accountant while becoming a key point of contact for day-to-day financial matters.

Your Role

The position covers a broad range of transactional accounts and bookkeeping responsibilities, with particular involvement in the financial administration of our managed properties.

Your responsibilities will include, but not limited to:
- Maintaining accurate day-to-day accounts across two group companies
- Raising sales invoices and processing tenant recharges
- Managing purchase ledger and supplier invoices
- Monitoring outstanding balances and chasing debtors
- Maintaining accurate tenant accounts and financial records
- Processing costs associated with landlords, utilities and service charges
- Dealing with invoices from contractors and other suppliers
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Maintaining accounting records within Sage
- Investigating and resolving day-to-day accounts queries
- Liaising with tenants, suppliers, landlords and contractors where required
- Working closely with the external accountant and providing financial information as required
- Supporting year-end accounting processes
- Assisting with other finance and accounts administration across the group

The nature of the business means there will be plenty of variety, and you will have the opportunity to develop a good understanding of both the financial and operational sides of the property portfolio.

Our ideal candidate

We are looking for someone with solid practical bookkeeping or accounts experience who is confident managing their own workload and maintaining accurate financial records.

You should have:
- Previous experience as an Accounts Assistant, Bookkeeper or in a similar finance position
- Practical experience using Sage
- AAT Level 3
- Experience of sales and purchase ledger
- Good knowledge of invoicing, reconciliations and credit control
- Strong numerical and administrative skills
- Good working knowledge of Excel
- Excellent attention to detail
- The confidence to communicate professionally with tenants, suppliers and other external contacts
- The ability to organise and prioritise your own workload

Experience within property, construction, commercial property or facilities management would be beneficial, although it is not essential.

A Flexible Part-Time Opportunity

We recognise that experienced people looking for part-time work often require some flexibility around their working pattern.

Our preference is approximately three days per week, although we are equally happy to consider spreading the hours across five shorter days, including a school-hours arrangement.

The position is office based at The Calls in Leeds city centre, working as part of a small, established team.

About Yorkshire Design Group

For more than 35 years, Yorkshire Design Group has been involved in the development and management of property in Leeds, combining property development with the ongoing management of its commercial assets.

As a family-owned business, we offer the opportunity to work within a close-knit organisation where you can take genuine responsibility for your area and build a long-term understanding of the business.

Interested? Please apply with your updated CV.

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims, predominantly EL & PL and Third-Party Property Damage losses.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle predominantly EL & PL claims through to settlement
- Manage your own dedicated caseload of Casualty claims and handling enquiries in relation to policy indemnity, legal liability and quantum
- Liaise with the Insurer, Policyholder and Broker
- Investigate allocated claims, looking at evidence and liaising with all relevant parties and determining liability
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Negotiate settlement where appropriate

description:
Commercial & Property Claims Handler

Location: Halifax - Hybrid

Overview:

We are working with one of the UK's leading loss adjusting companies who are looking for an experienced Commercial & Property Claims Handler to join its growing claims management team.

The role will see you supporting a key client across a number of bespoke insurance schemes, managing a varied caseload of commercial and residential property claims, including high value and more complex losses. You will manage claims from first notification through to settlement, ensuring they are handled efficiently and to a high standard throughout.

This is a hands on role where you will have real ownership of your claims, working closely with customers, clients, insurers and other stakeholders to keep everything moving and achieve the right outcome. You will be trusted to use your technical knowledge, make sound decisions and provide a high level of service throughout the claims process.

You will be joining a highly reputable business with long standing client relationships across the insurance sector, where there is a real focus on technical expertise, client relationships and delivering a quality service. It is a good opportunity for someone looking to build on their existing claims experience and become part of a supportive and growing team.

Role Responsibilities:
- Manage a caseload of commercial and residential property claims from first notification through to settlement.
- Deal with high value and complex claims, assessing the circumstances, liability and appropriate next steps.
- Investigate claims by gathering and reviewing relevant evidence, reports and supporting information.
- Review policy terms and assess whether claims are covered.
- Negotiate settlements within agreed authority levels.
- Work with external suppliers including loss adjusters, contractors, surveyors and legal representatives.
- Keep claims moving and make sure actions are followed up and completed within the required timescales.

Client & Stakeholder Management:
- Act as a key contact for a major client across a number of insurance schemes.
- Build good working relationships with brokers, policyholders, suppliers and internal teams.
- Keep clients and other stakeholders updated on claim progress, issues and any potential concerns.
- Provide a professional and customer focused service throughout the claims process.
- Deal with queries and more challenging situations calmly and professionally.

Compliance & Quality:
- Handle claims in line with regulatory requirements, internal processes and agreed client service levels.
- Keep claim files accurate, complete and up to date.
- Ensure claims systems are updated promptly with all relevant information.
- Identify potential fraud and raise any concerns through the appropriate channels.
- Keep an eye out for recurring issues, risks and areas where processes could be improved.
- Share knowledge and good claims handling practices with the wider team.
- Support improvements to claims processes, documentation and the overall service provided.

Experience:

We are looking for an experienced Claims Handler with a robust background in commercial and residential property claims.

You will ideally have:
- At least 2 years experience handling property claims
- Experience handling both commercial and residential property claims.
- Experience dealing with high value and complex property claims.
- A good understanding of property insurance policies, coverage and claims processes.
- Experience assessing claims information, reviewing evidence and making informed decisions on liability and settlement.
- Confident communication skills, with the ability to deal professionally with policyholders, clients, brokers and suppliers.
- Strong negotiation skills and the ability to reach appropriate settlements within agreed authority levels.
- Experience managing a caseload independently and keeping claims progressing within agreed timescales.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple claims and deadlines.
- Experience working with loss adjusters, contractors, surveyors and other external suppliers.
- Good written skills, with the ability to produce clear claim notes, correspondence and updates.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider claims team.

Career Development & Package:

This role offers the chance to take ownership of a varied caseload while continuing to build your technical knowledge across commercial and residential property claims. You will work with a range of clients and claim types, including high value and complex losses, giving you plenty of variety in your day to day work.

For those looking to progress, there are established opportunities to develop within claims handling, take on greater responsibility and move into more senior claims positions or progress into loss adjusting. There is also scope to broaden your experience across different areas of the business as your knowledge and expertise develops.

The role offers structured technical development, professional qualification support, hybrid working and a good level of autonomy over your caseload. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your claims, build trusted relationships with key clients and develop your career within an established and growing Property operation.

Alongside the career development on offer, the business provides a competitive benefits package, including a discretionary annual bonus, 5% contributory pension, private healthcare, death in service cover, 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with annual leave increasing with length of service. There is also an additional day off for your birthday, holiday purchase options, 24/7 GP access and a range of other employee benefits.

title: MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST
description: We need a reliable, motivated, hard working and flexible individual to join our friendly busy team. Must have SystmOne experience withgood computer and communication skills. To work 25.5 hours per week To commence as soon as possible. FLEXIBILITY IS ESSENTIAL TO THIS ROLE. Greeting and directing patients and visitors on arrival. Signposting patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional. Registering new patients. Booking appointments. Using photocopier, telephone, email and clinical system. Respond to the needs of clinicians during surgery. Respond to requests from Management. Preparing consultation rooms, prior to and after surgery. General housekeeping (e.g. keeping waiting and office areas clean and tidy). Action tasks on SystmOne Provide clerical assistance to support the delivery of patient services, e.g. post, data input and scanning. Specified Duties To provide and effective, polite and efficient point of contact to all patients and visitors to the Practice. To create and instil an atmosphere of calm, pleasant and peaceful surrounds. Maintain a positive attitude at all times. Smile when you answer the phone. Remember never say it is not my job to. Always say what you can do, not what you cannot do. Acknowledge and welcome the arrival of patients with a booked appointment at the front desk. Make future appointments and allocate appropriate same day appointments. Liaise with duty doctor via SystmOne any instructions regarding the processing of lists that are undertaken in line with the agreed procedure. Answer the telephone within 4 rings and ensure all messages are recorded in SystmOne and are dealt with or passed to the appropriate person for action. Deal with actions arising from the post when dealt with by the duty doctor. Deal with prescriptions requests and home visit requests as they come in, on the telephone and face to face. title: Practice Administrator
description: Warrengate Medical Centre is a busy and friendly town-centre Doctors surgery providing a full range of NHS services to a list size of more than 11,000 patients. We are a high achieving friendly training Practice with an excellent reputation situated in the Centre of Wakefield close to transport links and local amenities. We are committed to maintaining our high standard of patient care and customer service in a friendly and professional environment and we are currently looking a part time Practice Administrator to join our friendly team. This is a permanent position. The working patterns required are detailed below, however flexibility is required for covering annual leave and sickness absences. Wednesday : 8am - 4.30pm Thursday : 10am - 6.30pm Friday 8am - 4.30pm 5 Great reasons to join our Warrengate team: Inclusive and diverse workforce As a training practice we support and encourage career development Supportive team environment Automatic enrolment into NHS pension scheme and access to NHS discounts and benefits Staff wellbeing is at the heart of our family practice ethos. The candidates we are seeking should be experienced in delivering excellent customer service, maintaining professionalism, discretion and confidentiality at all times and able to work well under pressure both independently, and as part of a team. You will need to have excellent communication and organisational skills, together with a caring and solution focused approach to patient related problems. The main duties will be answering phones and dealing with patients face to face, care navigating patients to the most appropriate person / service to help, dealing with repeat prescriptions, scanning, managing patient related tasks as directed by the Practice team. You will have the ability to remain calm in difficult situations as well as having the initiative to identify outstanding workload and support the team in completing this. Flexibility to cover colleagues annual leave and sickness is essential. Full training will be given but Medical Administration and Receptionist experience in a similar environment would be advantageous. The Receptionist/Care Navigator is key front-line position responsible for managing the first impressions of the practice. This role involves greeting patients, managing communication between patients and medical staff and facilitating patient access to appropriate healthcare services. The Care Receptionist/Care Navigator plays a crucial role in guiding patients through the complexities of healthcare interactions, ensuring they receive timely and appropriate care. Key responsibilities include scheduling appointments, managing patient records, answering phone calls and providing patients with information about healthcare services. The Receptionist/Care Navigator will ensure that all patient interactions are handled with empathy and efficiency, maintaining confidentiality and compliance with healthcare regulations. This position requires excellent communication skills, strong organisational abilities and a patient-based approach to service delivery. Main duties of the job: Front Desk Management, Appointment booking following Care Navigation triage, Telephone enquiries, eConsultations - Process eConsultations received - Patchs, Patient records management, Summarising, Administrative work as required, - practice email Patient follow-up, Service enhancement initiatives, Training participation, Knowledge upgrading
